args.summary:
Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island: Biscoe 37.25, Dream 37.47, Torgersen 39.21 (24 Adelie rows used).

Problems found and fixed:
1. Island label misspellings — "Dram" (2 rows) and "Torgerson" (1 row) were not in the allowed list {Biscoe, Dream, Torgersen}. Merged into "Dream" and "Torgersen" with normalize_labels (approved). This mattered directly: the "Dram" rows are Adelie penguins that would otherwise have formed a bogus fourth island group.
2. Exact duplicate rows — rows 9 and 22 were identical copies of earlier rows; dropped (approved) so no penguin was counted twice in the averages.

Checked and clean: bill_length_mm (no missing values, no text-stored numbers, no negatives, all within the rules range 30–60), species labels (all valid, no variants).

Caveats / left alone (not used by this question): sex has a case variant "FEMALE" (2 rows) vs "female", and body_mass_g has 2 values stored as text with thousands separators (e.g. "3,600"). Neither affects the bill-length-by-island answer, so I did not change them; they should be cleaned before any analysis that uses sex or body mass.
